The '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the Jedi was present at the Temple during the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|Bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]] and he then attended the [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims]].

==Biography==
[[File:TempleBombingFuneral.png|thumb|left|280px|The Jedi attended the Funeral of the temple bombing victims.]]
The [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]<ref name="Sabotage" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="EP18">''{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-jedi-who-knew-too-much-episode-guide|text="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}''</ref> lived during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Jedi was sensitive to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and was brought to the Temple. He received training in the ways of the Jedi and became a Jedi.<ref name="Sabotage" />

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="DS1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> when the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombed]]<ref name="Sabotage" /> by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]<ref name="TWJEPG">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep520|text="The Wrong Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}''</ref> [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]],<ref name="TWJ">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref> the Jedi was present at the Temple.<ref name="Sabotage" /> He then attended the [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims]].<ref name="TJWKTM" />
